headlines.title: Xi greets Trump as he arrives in China, a rare move ahead of Putin talks
headlines.description: In a rare and surprising move, Chinese leader Xi Jinping personally greeted President Donald Trump as he arrived in China on Wednesday ahead of historic three-way talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin.

headlines.title: Democrat Mary Peltola Wins Alaska Senate Race in Major Upset
headlines.description: Democrats extended their upcoming advantage on Capitol Hill after Mary Peltola narrowly defeated Republican incumbent Dan Sullivan in Alaska’s closely-watched Senate race that came with intense controversy over an alleged plot to sabotage the campaign of Sullivan by placing another candidate on the ballot with the same name. NBC’s Ryan Nobles reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Trump Lands in China Ahead of Historic Meeting with Xi and Putin
headlines.description: President Donald Trump touched down in China Wednesday ahead of a historic three-way meeting with the presidents of China and Russia on Thursday, which Trump says will focus on denuclearization and global security along with the conflicts in Ukraine and Iran. NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Special Report: Trump says alliance between U.S. and the Philippines strengthened with new deal
headlines.description: Watch the full special report as President Donald Trump delivered remarks during a banquet with Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. as part of the ASEAN summit. Trump announced a new trade deal between the countries, calling it “magnificent.”

headlines.title: How the White House Correspondents’ Association dinner chaos unfolded
headlines.description: Secret Service faced challenges evacuating President, Vice President, Cabinet officials and Congressional leaders after gunman rushes D.C. gala.

headlines.title: Amid string of outages, bipartisan letter urges strategy to combat AI-assisted cyber threats
headlines.description: In the midst of a series of recent cyber outages, there is growing concern by members of Congress that the Trump administration needs to do more to protect infrastructure from cyberattacks that are aided by AI, according to a new bipartisan letter sent by two senators to the White House’s AI czar.

headlines.title: White House drops Heidi Overton’s FDA nomination after Republicans raise concerns
headlines.description: The White House is dropping Dr. Heidi Overton’s nomination to lead the Food and Drug Administration, a White House official confirmed Tuesday.

headlines.title: Sean Duffy’s $50B demand for air travel fixes is met with yelling and skepticism in Congress
headlines.description: The Trump administration’s request for $50.1 billion in new FAA funding after a nationwide ground stop is running into skepticism from both parties in Congress.

headlines.title: Classified NSA network went down, but no indication it was an attack, sources say
headlines.description: A classified computer network used by the National Security Agency went down due to a technical problem Tuesday, but there was no indication that it was an attack, sources say

headlines.title: Democrats with 2028 ambitions say their party still must prove itself to win the White House: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, Natasha Korecki files a dispatch from a recent gathering of jubilant, but forward-looking, Democrats in Denver.
